newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanghai Ind seen placing shares - sources.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Ind seen placing shares - sources.

text.p: Shanghai Industrial Holdings Ltd is expected to place 40 million shares at HK$19.50 per share to fund future asset acquisitions, market sources said on Friday.
They said Peregrine Capital and Morgan Stanley Asia were expected to be joint lead managers of the placement.
Trading in Shanghai Industrial shares was suspended at the company's request pending an annoucement. The stock closed at HK$21.20 on Thursday.
Officials at Shanghai Industrial and Morgan Stanley were not immediately available. Peregrine Capital declined to comment.
